annotations.title: Employment package for a private household

description: Everything a Swiss private household needs to employ a cleaner, nanny or carer legally, in one call, from the canton, the weekly hours and the gross hourly wage: the employment plan grouped by deadline (before the first working day, in the first month, every year) with real dates when a start date is given; the monthly and annual employer cost and the worker's net wage with every deduction and contribution; the minimum-wage check at the workplace; the terms the employment contract must contain under the canton's standard employment contract (probation, notice, vacation weeks, supplements, public holidays, 13th month, sick pay), each with its article; the official sources and prefilled clino.ch links (contract generator, calculator, canton guide). Use it when the user wants the complete package or a file to keep; for one question (only the cost, only the minimum wage, only the contract) the single tools answer faster. The output keys are fixed. The workplace must be in the household's canton.

canton.description: Swiss canton: two-letter code (ZH, BE, GE, VD, TI...) or its name in German, French, Italian or English (Zürich, Genève, Ticino, Basel-Stadt). For employer contributions this is the canton where the household lives.

hourly_wage_chf.description: Agreed GROSS hourly wage in CHF, before the vacation supplement (e.g. 30).

hours_per_week.description: Average working hours per week with this household (e.g. 4).

language.description: Language of the explanatory texts and of the clino.ch links: en, de, fr, it, es or pt. Default en.

role.description: What the worker does: cleaner (household help), nanny (childcare, babysitter), carer (care of an elderly or disabled person) or other. Sets which contract template and guide the links open.

skill_level.description: Qualification of the worker for the minimum-wage check. Default unskilled, the lowest tier.

start_date.description: First working day, YYYY-MM-DD. With it every step of the plan gets its due date (registration deadline, first payslip, annual declaration) and the probation its last day.

worker_age.description: Age of the worker in years. Sets the paid vacation weeks (more under 20 and, in some cantons, from 50 or 60), which the cost then prices. Never a birthdate.

workplace_postcode.description: 4-digit Swiss postcode (PLZ/NPA) of the workplace, in the household's canton. City minimum wages (e.g. Stadt Luzern) depend on it.

name: get_employment_package

canton.description: The canton where the household lives: its compensation office collects the contributions.

non_occupational_accident_insurance.description: true from 8 hours a week: the worker is also insured for accidents outside work (premium deducted from her wage).

pension_fund_bvg.description: true when the annual wage passes the BVG entry threshold, so the worker must be insured in a pension fund.

registration_window.description: Only with a start date. 'elapsed' is a fact to raise with the compensation office, which can still accept a late registration.

canton.description: The canton whose standard employment contract governs (the workplace).

explanation.description: What binding means for the contract: which terms a written contract may change.

instrument.description: Official title of the canton's standard employment contract for household work (NAV / CTT / CNL), or null where none governs this relationship and only the Code of Obligations applies.

summary.description: Two or three sentences a person can read first.

full_time_week_hours.description: Normal full-time week under the instrument; null where it sets none.

steps.description: Notice in months to the end of a month, by service year (1 = first year).

no_supplement_exception.description: Hours on which the instrument itself owes no overtime supplement (ZH/OW part-time staff, UR part-timers, LU 43rd to 45th hour); null where supplement_percent applies to every hour above the contract.

ends_on.description: Last day of the probation, when a start date was given.

legal_basis.description: Article and instrument the value comes from, or the Code of Obligations article where the canton's contract is silent.

notice_days.description: Notice during probation, in calendar days.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence of the instrument that states the value; null where the Code of Obligations applies.

rules.description: The full scale: base, under 20 and any age or service steps.

weeks.description: Paid vacation weeks a year for this worker (with worker_age; else the adult base).

written_terms.description: What the employer must confirm in writing even without a signed contract.

vaud_pc_familles.description: Vaud only: employer share of PC Familles (family supplementary benefits, LPCFam).

total_employer_cost.description: Gross wage + employer contributions + approximate admin fee of the compensation office. No service fee of any provider included.

data_verified_on.description: Date the rate set was last checked against the official sources.

vacation_weeks.description: Paid vacation weeks the cost prices: the contract terms' entitlement for this worker.

contract_generator.description: Clino's free contract generator for this role, prefilled with the figures (no personal data in the link).

binding_floor_chf_per_hour.description: The gross hourly minimum that binds for the given hours (from 5 h/week if no hours were given). null = no statutory floor binds at these hours.

city_minimum_uncertain.description: true when the canton has a city minimum but the workplace postcode was not given or straddles a boundary: the floor may be higher.

status.description: below_minimum: the gross hourly wage (without the vacation supplement) is below the floor that binds at these hours. The package still answers; the wage has to be raised.

paperwork_help.description: Only relevant when the user asks who can prepare the contract, registration and payslips for them. Not an answer to any other question.

covers_steps.description: The step numbers above that Clino prepares.

link.description: Clino page explaining how it works.

what.description: What Clino prepares, in the requested language. The household signs, submits and pays itself.

plan.description: The steps of get_hiring_checklist, grouped by when they are due. A step with applies false does not apply to this household; why says so.

before_day_one.description: Before the first working day: contract, accident insurance, and the pension fund and sickness insurance where they apply.

applies.description: false when this step does not apply to this household, with the reason in why.

detail.description: What to do, in the requested language (Clino's fact sheet wording).

due_date.description: ISO date the step is due, when a start date was given and the step has a deadline.

first_month.description: In the first month: registration with the compensation office (30 days) and the first payslip.

yearly.description: Every year: the annual wage declaration by 30 January.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence of the source that states the value.

summary.description: The plan, the cost, the wage check and the contract in a few sentences a person can read first.

title: Employment package for a private household
